card.name: Lists of allergic reaction types
card.fires_on: Words and punctuation right before or inside a list of hypersensitivity reactions, such as 'include', commas between items, and the start of 'urticaria' or 'Drug Rash'. It fires where the next item is a skin or allergic reaction like SJS/TEN, urticaria or DRESS.

modes.label: Verb introducing reactions
modes.description: The word include or included right after 'hypersensitivity reactions' or 'reactions have'.
modes.example: These hypersensitivity reactions<< include>> SJS/TEN, maculop

modes.label: Inside the reaction list
modes.description: A comma, 'e.g.,' or the start of a split word within a list of rash and allergy terms.
modes.example: include pruritus, headache, pyrexia, rash,<< ur>>ticaria, hypotension (including

modes.description: The word Drug at the start of 'Drug Rash with Eosinophilia and Systemic Symptoms'.
